threads.body: [Testing] This case only verifies that a retired configuration key is ignored. Repository test guidance excludes tests for removed settings because they turn unsupported input into a maintained contract; the supported precedence/default matrices above already cover the remaining behavior. Please remove the deprecated-setting-only cases and the deprecated-key stubs from the supported precedence cases in this class.

replies.body: Removed the deprecated-setting-only cases and retired-key stubs while retaining supported precedence/default coverage. Commit: `af99fff831`.

threads.body:
[Testing] Setting the retired property makes this supported system-property matrix also test that removed configuration is ignored, which repository guidance explicitly excludes. The JDBC/common/default matrix is complete without this setup, so delete this line.

This issue also appears on line 111 of the same file.

replies.body: Removed the retired property setup, reset, and declarative stubs from the supported JDBC configuration test. Commit: `af99fff831`.

+- Remove the retired flat settings `otel.instrumentation.common.db-statement-sanitizer.enabled`
+  and `otel.instrumentation.<module>.statement-sanitizer.enabled`; use
+  `otel.instrumentation.common.db.query-sanitization.enabled` and

threads.body: [Config] This migration note only names the removed flat aliases, but the same change also removes the declarative `java.common.database.statement_sanitizer.enabled` and `java.<module>.statement_sanitizer.enabled` keys. As written, YAML users are not told that their settings will stop applying in 3.0 or which declarative replacements to use; please document both removed surfaces.
